The Complete Printed Workbook
Own the Physical Workbook

The Becoming Her workbook is a complete 29-chapter discipleship guide designed for young women ready to grow in faith, wisdom, identity, and purpose.

Perfect for individual study, small groups, mentorship programs, and youth ministries. Each chapter includes Scripture, teaching, reflection questions, journal space, prayer, and weekly challenges.

✅ 29 chapters across 8 life-changing sections
✅ Faith, identity, relationships, health, money and purpose
✅ Written for young women ages 16 and up
✅ Ideal for small groups, youth ministry, and mentorship

🏫 Perfect for Groups

This workbook is ideal for small groups, youth ministries, mentorship programs, and classrooms. Bulk discounts are available. Contact us for group pricing and ordering details.
